name: Bernalillo County, NM
findings: Bernalillo County has 2,169 nonprofit organizations. 993 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 835 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Bernalillo County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Professional organizations stand out for civic or political action
observations.text: 28 professional organizations here list civic or political action, compared with about 2 in similar places of this size.
